description: We are Tuwaiq Space, a team from Jeddah's technical high school for gifted students, established in partnership with Tuwaiq Academy. Our proposed project, Rahat Relay, will compare open elevation data from Harrat Rahat, the Moon, and Mars to identify a Saudi site for simulating how terrain blocks the line of sight between a rover and its base. Our interests include coding, geospatial analysis, and data visualization. We are not recruiting additional team members at this time.
